objectives.label: Clear the brigands from the lord's road

title: The lord's road
Brigands on the high road
summary: Brigands have taken to the lord's road {direction} of {settlement}. The lord wants them gone.
offer: Tolls are down by half and his lordship is not pleased. A band of brigands works the high road {distance} {direction} of here. He has asked for you by name.
progress: The road is still not safe.
complete: His lordship is pleased. That is not a small thing.
